queries.sql: SELECT q.*, c.title AS course_title, c.teacher_id AS course_teacher_id, sub.name AS subject_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM questions qs WHERE qs.quiz_id = q.id) AS question_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qs2.points), 0) FROM questions qs2 WHERE qs2.quiz_id = q.id) AS total_points FROM `quizzes` `q` JOIN `courses` `c` ON `c`.`id` = `q`.`course_id` LEFT JOIN `subjects` `sub` ON `sub`.`id` = `c`.`subject_id` JOIN `course_students` `cs` ON `cs`.`course_id` = `q`.`course_id` WHERE `q`.`id` = 20 AND `q`.`is_published` = 1 AND `cs`.`student_id` = 1
